collection.name: S² Forge
collection.tagline: Expand what social science can study.
collection.description: A curated collection of agent skills for valid, transparent, and auditable social science research.

skills.name: Research Workspace Builder
skills.description: Turns open questions and repeated-case study designs into transparent, auditable, evidence-linked research workspaces.
best_for: questions that need reusable, line-cited evidence
many cases researched under shared guidance
research that must preserve conflicts and unresolved gaps
not_for: a one-off answer that does not need a reusable workspace
automatically treating generated conclusions as substantively valid
unreviewed use with sensitive data or unrestricted host permissions
requirements: a configured search backend for online research

capabilities.filesystem: Writes inside the generated research workspace.
capabilities.network: Optional for online research; restricted to configured research providers under the safe defaults.
capabilities.commands: Runs bundled Python validation, routing, retrieval, and launcher scripts.
capabilities.external_actions: Searches and retrieves public sources when the user authorizes a live run.

citation.related_preprint: Agentic Framework for Political Biography Extraction
